information: Teleports you to your current spawn point, if it is in the same dimension.
In the Overworld, if it is obstructed, you will be placed at the world spawn instead.
To use in the Nether, you must have a Respawn Anchor with charges remaining.
If your spawnpoint is unsafe, it will attempt to place you directly above/below.
If no safe location can be found, the potion will fail and won't be used up.
